description: Use when someone asks whether they need a LIS or POCT middleware, the difference between them, or how Catenix compares with another point-of-care data manager or results connector (Relaymed, TELCOR QML, Abbott RALS or AegisPOC, Siemens POCcelerator, Radiometer AQURE, Roche navify POC Operations, Clinisys POCT, paper or spreadsheet lab logs). Returns only what the published comparison pages say. name: compare_options
title: Compare LIS vs POCT middleware, or Catenix vs another product
